title: Solitude
selectionError: Unknown flight mode. Choose a flight from the menu.
suspensionBody: Flight stopped while the window was inactive or timing was interrupted. Resume when you are ready.
briefing: Automatic orbit recovery is offline. Your trajectory intersects Earth. First press G to show the predicted orbit line with Earth to your left. Then press Z to align the nose along the orbit and roll Earth above the ship. Wait for the view to settle, then hold Space to raise the lowest point to at least 150 km while keeping the highest at or below 600 km. Release and coast for five seconds. B thrusts backwards to correct an overshoot.
completedBody: You held a safe Earth orbit for five seconds without propulsion. Recovery complete.
failedBody: Your craft crossed the 80 km Earth altitude boundary. Retry to recover the orbit.
